description: Networks of logic gates wired as bipartite expander graphs, or as a Vandermonde matrix update over a finite field, reach high integrated information while performing nothing intelligent.
limitations: Uses the IIT 2.0 era measure. The originators accept that such systems could be conscious rather than treating this as a refutation.

sources.quote: we can achieve pretty good information integration by hooking together logic gates according to any bipartite expander graph
